device_type.description: Device type to use. Possible values are: 'cuda', 'cpu', 'mtia', 'maia', 'xpu', and so on. The type is the same as the `type` attribute of a :class:`torch.device`. Thus, you may obtain the device type of a tensor using `Tensor.device.type`.
constraints: Must be one of the following: 'cuda', 'cpu', 'mtia', 'maia', 'xpu', etc.
device_type must be one of cuda, cpu, mtia, maia, xpu, torch.device, Tensor.device.type
